purpose: Prioritize evidence collection among eligible bounded cases; cannot approve implementation or certify benefits.

criterion_definitions.evidence_readiness: Availability and usability of the minimum required records; distinguish possession from authentication and completeness.
criterion_definitions.operational_importance: Consequences for required mandate outputs, safety, readiness and service continuity within a defined work slice.
criterion_definitions.reform_relevance: Specificity and strength of the documented link to an applicable adopted provision; proposals remain distinguishable.
criterion_definitions.feasibility: Practical ability to obtain evidence and evaluate a reversible alternative, including owner acceptance, burden and constraints.
criterion_definitions.measurement_value: Ability of the proposed measurement to resolve a consequential decision uncertainty beyond existing evidence.

criterion_domain: Finite decimal string from 0 through 1 with case-specific rubric/source receipt. No default value for missing evidence.
weight_policy: An explicitly reviewed vector must include every criterion, nonnegative decimal weights summing exactly to one, with weight_receipt. No approved weights currently exist.
formula: Sum weight times declared normalized criterion value after all guards pass.
critical_gate_rule: FAIL blocks scoring; missing, UNKNOWN or unauthenticated guard declarations make case UNSCORABLE; money never offsets safeguard failure.
advancement_authority: None; candidate advancement and institutional approval remain separate.
